narrative.overview:
A light-filled studio in Lebanese afternoon light, seen through arched windows. Soft, unhurried and hand-made: blush-white grounds carry a single deep rose field, photographs of her work sit inside arch-topped frames, and every action is a soft pill. Surfaces are tactile rather than glossy: a pre-rendered paper grain lies under every section, and cards sit on layered, downward shadows as if on a sunlit table.

The system is bilingual by construction. English and Arabic are two equal pairings, not a translation layer: Fraunces light over Manrope, Amiri over Readex Pro, each with its own leading, tracking and size, and a handwritten signature in each script (Mrs Saint Delafield, Aref Ruqaa). Every layout is written in logical properties so Arabic mirrors without a second stylesheet. Density is low on phones (one idea per viewport) and composes onto a 12-column grid on desktop where photos break the grid, overlapping section edges.

Motion is warm and brief: things settle and rise into place with an expo ease, the rose field floods in, a signature writes itself in the reading direction. Content is always present in the HTML without JavaScript; motion only decorates arrival.
keyCharacteristics: Blush-white grounds with a light, rose-toned pre-rendered grain; one deep rose field per page.
Arch-topped photo frames (fully rounded top, small-radius foot) as the recurring silhouette.
Pill actions only; one Book destination.
Fraunces light display with italic emphasis marked by the CMS; Amiri in Arabic, never slanted.
Layered, rose-tinted, downward shadows; no hard or offset shadows.
Logical CSS everywhere; directional icons and motion mirror in RTL.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: Deep rose floods exactly one section per page (services). Elsewhere clay is a point accent: a pill, a badge, a line of type.

rules.name: The Sage Is WhatsApp Rule
rules.body: Sage marks the WhatsApp channel and nothing else: not accent lines, not icons, never a general secondary button colour.

rules.name: The Blush Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral, shadow and placeholder stripe is tinted from ink (rgb 44 35 38) or rose; no pure black, white or cool grey appears anywhere.

rules.name: The Starred Emphasis Rule
rules.body: Heading emphasis comes from the CMS as `*stars*` and renders as italic `em`. Never hard-code emphasis in a component; never emphasise more than a phrase.

rules.name: The No Fake Italic Rule
rules.body: Arabic has no italics: `:lang(ar) em` is upright and keeps its colour. Never slant or skew Arabic text, and never apply negative tracking to a connected script.

rules.name: The Two Pairings Rule
rules.body: Each language loads and uses only its own faces. A cross-script accent line names its family explicitly (Amiri in English pages, Fraunces italic in Arabic pages) and carries its own `lang` and `dir`.

rules.name: The Logical Only Rule
rules.body: Layout uses logical properties and utilities (start/end, ps/pe, ms/me, inset-inline). Physical left/right classes fail `npm run lint` (`scripts/check-logical-css.mjs`). Direction-dependent transforms use `rtl:` variants.

rules.name: The Sunlight Falls Down Rule
rules.body: Shadows are soft, layered and offset downward (the bar alone casts upward because it sits at the bottom edge). No hard offset shadows, no glows, no coloured neon.

rules.name: The Baked Grain Rule
rules.body: Grain is a pre-rendered tile painted with the background. Never a live SVG `feTurbulence` filter, never a fixed overlay that re-rasterizes on scroll.

rules.name: The Visible Without JS Rule
rules.body: The server renders everything visible. CSS keyframes run from the HTML; scroll reveals only set start states on elements still below the fold after hydration; overlay layers start at opacity 0.

rules.name: The Compositor Only Rule
rules.body: Animate transform, opacity and clip-path only. Springs animate full transform strings. Under `prefers-reduced-motion` every reveal becomes a 0.3s fade and ambient loops stop.

dos: Do use `PillLink` for every action and `bookingHref()` for every Book destination.
Do frame her photos in arches through `Picture`, with an honest placeholder until the real photo exists.
Do mark heading emphasis with `*stars*` in the CMS and let `Emphasis` render it.
Do write layout in logical properties; the lint step enforces it.
Do give Arabic its own faces, leading (1.25 display, 1.75 body), zero tracking and upright emphasis.
Do paint the pre-rendered grain with each section background.
Do keep content visible without JavaScript and reduce motion to short fades.
Do keep touch targets at least 2.75rem.
donts: Don't flood more than one section with clay, or use sage for anything but WhatsApp.
Don't add eyebrows or kickers above headings; headings stand alone.
Don't use hard offset shadows, glows or pure black shadows.
Don't italicize, skew or letter-space Arabic.
Don't use physical left/right utilities or hand-mirror layouts.
Don't use stock, AI-generated or icon-font imagery; icons come from the one authored SVG set.
Don't animate layout properties or run live SVG noise filters.
Don't introduce a second button shape or hard-code a WhatsApp link for booking.
